MUSIC LANE (all tracks pinned): NO bed in the cold open (0-~27s); comedic upbeat-1 (Monkeys Spinning Monkeys) from 'It all started with a soldier' to 'made himself the prince'; a NEW boundary at 'And making things up was nothing new' switches to upbeat-3 (Ascending the Vale, the Fig-Leaf-register middle-span pick) through the con build; upbeat-2 (Fig Leaf Times Two) on the 1822 London mania; underscore-1 (Crypto) on the collapse + survivors; a NEW boundary at 'After the news broke' returns to upbeat-1 for the Paris caper; somber-1 elegiac button from 'But the guidebook is still here'. Two human-cost `dry` spans + the elegiac `dry` carve silence through the underscore. SFX: pops on the paradise/absence chains + the 3-way Colombia/Peru/Chile split (per-country figure reveals); stamp-slam booms (consistent boom-1) on FICTION/FAKE/didn't-exist; choir halo_vocal (REPLACES the harp-gliss halo) x3 on the guidebook float, 'Everybody wanted in', and MacGregor's ironic sainthood; sparkle-2 (longer whimsy) pinned on the book-pages reveal + the gold; boo on the fraud reveal, applause on the flag gag, buzzer 'no' on the cancelled grant. ~15 authored pauses (was 7), densified per M13 incl. the TTS chunk seams. Human-cost act stays dry + SFX-withheld. Tail-law: long SFX are paired with same-anchor pauses sized to ring out inside their scene (M20); remaining tail overshoots (boo, applause, halo-into-riser, sparkle-into-pages) are deliberate soft/decaying tails, WARN-only. See visual-kit/audio-tokens.json for pools + dials.
